blocks.heading: A short route from store to soil

body.html:
A catalogue can tell you what is in a bag. It cannot tell you whether it fits this hillside, this rain window, or this budget.

That is why every order starts with a small field note: location, crop, planting window, and acreage. The answer stays short enough to use.

blocks.body: Tell us what you are planting, where the field is, and when the soil needs to be ready.
